text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement!
The 'Summer Sprint Series' is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What might that be?
Is it fun? Is it delicious?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: If I had to put it in a word, "interesting."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement!
If you achieve great results in the summer sprint races,
you might become... this summer's fastest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is rather vague.
Are you saying there is a chance I cannot become one?
choice_data_list: The Summer Sprint Series uses a points system, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Points are awarded based on results in the eligible races,
and the Umamusume with the highest total points
will be crowned the Summer Sprint Series Champion.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In other words, I have to run in multiple races, right?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative!
Hence, taking on the challenge is entirely optional!
Prioritizing summer camp training poses no issue whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're taking on the Summer Sprint Series,
the Centaur Stakes is a must.
As the only GII in the series, it offers high points.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Ibis Summer Dash also awards points.
If we want to conquer the series, we'll need to win
at least one other race as well.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Either way is fine with me.
I'll leave it to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In addition to the Ibis Summer Dash,
victory in the Centaur Stakes is a must. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "A good benchmark is winning at least one of these: the Hakodate Sprint Stakes, CBC Sho, Kitakyushu Kinen, or Keeneland Cup."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Should we take on the Summer Sprint Series...?
Let's think about it a little more.
